headline: [Beren Cross] Daniel Farke and Leeds reach agreement in principle over new contract to 2029
body: Daniel Farke and Leeds United have reached an agreement in principle on a new contract running to 2029. The formalities of the deal still need to be finalised before it can be signed, but there is broad agreement on both sides about how it will be structured, according to sources with knowledge of the process, not authorised to discuss it publicly. The manager’s current contract expires at the end of this season. Farke has been asked about his future in several press conferences since the start of the campaign.   submitted by   /u/TheAthletic [link]   [comments]
